rows: Shoot the centipede segments in the mushroom field
Bounce the ball through the brick wall
Defend your castle corner from the bouncing fireball

widgets.text:
Centipede: stay low, kill the flea that seeds mushrooms; the spider gives most points close up.
Breakout: break through the side for the ball to bounce behind the wall.
Warlords: catch and aim the fireball at a weak castle wall.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Classic and enhanced versions of each game; Warlords has 4-player link.
Centipede: head 100, body 10, spider 300-900, flea 200, scorpion 1000.
Three Atari arcade classics on one cart.
Score attack: high scores are saved per game.
